Addresses oss-fuzz issue 61394: + "graphicsmagick:coder_WPG_fuzzer: Use-of-uninitialized-value in + GrayscalePseudoClassImage". + 2023-10-08 Bob Friesenhahn * coders/heif.c (ReadHEIFImage): Call heif_init() and diff --git a/VisualMagick/installer/inc/version.isx b/VisualMagick/installer/inc/version.isx index e981a3d54d228cdf13236d74b583c02d19f0565f_VmlzdWFsTWFnaWNrL2luc3RhbGxlci9pbmMvdmVyc2lvbi5pc3g=..2fd2e662359d6ef85b0507f09a1a905233749b57_VmlzdWFsTWFnaWNrL2luc3RhbGxlci9pbmMvdmVyc2lvbi5pc3g= 100644 --- a/VisualMagick/installer/inc/version.isx +++ b/VisualMagick/installer/inc/version.isx @@ -10,5 +10,5 @@ #define public MagickPackageName "GraphicsMagick" #define public MagickPackageVersion "1.4" -#define public MagickPackageVersionAddendum ".020231008" -#define public MagickPackageReleaseDate "snapshot-20231008" +#define public MagickPackageVersionAddendum ".020231014" +#define public MagickPackageReleaseDate "snapshot-20231014" diff --git a/coders/wpg.c b/coders/wpg.c index e981a3d54d228cdf13236d74b583c02d19f0565f_Y29kZXJzL3dwZy5j..2fd2e662359d6ef85b0507f09a1a905233749b57_Y29kZXJzL3dwZy5j 100644 --- a/coders/wpg.c +++ b/coders/wpg.c @@ -1602,9 +1602,37 @@ (((WPG_Palette.NumOfEntries-WPG_Palette.StartIndex) > ((Rec2.RecordLength-2-2) / 3))) ) ThrowReaderException(CorruptImageError,InvalidColormapIndex,image); - + /* Make sure that indexes contain initialized data if + promoting from DirectClass. This is a stop-gap + measure until independent colormap support is + developed. */ + if (PseudoClass != image->storage_class) + { + unsigned long y; + IndexPacket *indexes; + PixelPacket *p; + MagickBool get = GetPixelCachePresent(image); + image->storage_class = PseudoClass; + for (y=0; y < image->rows; y++) + { + if (get) + p=GetImagePixels(image,0,y,image->columns,1); + else + p=SetImagePixels(image,0,y,image->columns,1); + if (p == (const PixelPacket *) NULL) + break; + indexes=AccessMutableIndexes(image); + if (indexes == (IndexPacket *) NULL) + break; + (void) memset(indexes,0,sizeof(IndexPacket)*image->columns); + if (!SyncImagePixels(image)) + break; + } + if (y != image->rows) + ThrowReaderException(CacheError,UnableToGetPixelsFromCache,image); + } image->colors=WPG_Palette.NumOfEntries; - if (!AllocateImageColormap(image,image->colors)) /* FIXME: Oss-fuzz 61394, Trashes image->storage_class of previous image, which might be from ExtractPostscript()! */ + if (!AllocateImageColormap(image,image->colors)) ThrowReaderException(ResourceLimitError,MemoryAllocationFailed,image); for (i=WPG_Palette.StartIndex; diff --git a/magick/blob.c b/magick/blob.c index e981a3d54d228cdf13236d74b583c02d19f0565f_bWFnaWNrL2Jsb2IuYw==..2fd2e662359d6ef85b0507f09a1a905233749b57_bWFnaWNrL2Jsb2IuYw== 100644 --- a/magick/blob.c +++ b/magick/blob.c @@ -2732,7 +2732,7 @@ Form filename for multi-part images. */ if (MagickSceneFileName(filename,image->filename,"",MagickFalse, - GetImageIndexInList(image))) + GetImageIndexInList(image))) /* FIXME: Could use image->scene */ (void) strlcpy(image->filename,filename,MaxTextExtent); if (!image_info->adjoin) diff --git a/magick/version.h b/magick/version.h index e981a3d54d228cdf13236d74b583c02d19f0565f_bWFnaWNrL3ZlcnNpb24uaA==..2fd2e662359d6ef85b0507f09a1a905233749b57_bWFnaWNrL3ZlcnNpb24uaA== 100644 --- a/magick/version.h +++ b/magick/version.h @@ -38,8 +38,8 @@ #define MagickLibVersion 0x272404 #define MagickLibVersionText "1.4" #define MagickLibVersionNumber 27,24,4 -#define MagickChangeDate "20231008" -#define MagickReleaseDate "snapshot-20231008" +#define MagickChangeDate "20231014" +#define MagickReleaseDate "snapshot-20231014" /* The MagickLibInterfaceNewest and MagickLibInterfaceOldest defines diff --git a/www/Changelog.html b/www/Changelog.html index e981a3d54d228cdf13236d74b583c02d19f0565f_d3d3L0NoYW5nZWxvZy5odG1s..2fd2e662359d6ef85b0507f09a1a905233749b57_d3d3L0NoYW5nZWxvZy5odG1s 100644 --- a/www/Changelog.html +++ b/www/Changelog.html @@ -37,6 +37,16 @@
